title: Gridlock simulation: multi-region GPU exhaustion + dependency silence
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Run a coordinated fault-injection campaign that exercises a realistic production failure mode we call 'gridlock': simultaneous regional ejection + progressive GPU pool depletion while a critical downstream (auth/kv) becomes silent. Goal: validate SLOs, circuit-breaker behavior, autoscaling and load-shedding policies, and failover correctness across three regions (us-west1, eu-west1, ap-south1). This ticket covers test design, harness implementation, runbook updates, and experiment runs with observability and postmortem artifacts.
motivation: We've observed combinations of partial region overload and transient downstream outages in staging runs; we need to ensure that combined failure modes don't cause systemic request queues, extended tail latency, or cache corruption. This exercise should prove our circuit breakers, request routing fallback, and shedding heuristics maintain customer-facing SLOs under pathological but plausible conditions.
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic workload can reproduce gridlock with >90% probability given configured knobs
Under gridlock, P95 latency for text-generation endpoints stays within 2x baseline and P99 is bounded by documented graceful-degradation policy
No request is stuck indefinitely; KV cache must not overflow or leak across tenants
Automatic fallback to remote-region model variant succeeds for 95% of affected requests within 30s
Circuit breakers trip and recover per policy documented in runtime-1.20; incidents triggered and runbook steps exercised
Post-run postmortem includes actionable fixes and updated runbook within 7 days
test_plan: Phase A: unit and small-scale dry-run in a dev zone (us-west1-dev) to validate harness safety. Phase B: canary in test prod with 1% of traffic for each region; validate metrics and abort conditions. Phase C: progressive escalation to 20% traffic and cross-region ejection simulation combined with GPU preemption (simulate GPU pool capacity ratio at 30%, 10%, 2%). For dependency silence, inject 503 and full TCP blackhole into auth and kv proxies with randomized durations (30s-180s). Metrics to capture: token latency histograms, queue lengths, continuous batching sizes, circuit-breaker open counts, model-variant fallback success rate, and request cost deltas. Abort immediately on increased error budget burn >30% in any customer org.
harness_changes: Extend chaos-runner with: 1) orchestrated region-ejection API that drains control plane watchers then reintroduces nodes, 2) a GPU-pressure generator that allocates ephemeral workloads to saturate node pools without requiring actual preemptions, 3) dependency-silence mode that blackholes TCP connections at the proxy layer and inserts 503 spikes. Add safety gates: kill-switch TTL, leader-only execution, and rate limits on injected failure percentage.
observability: Dashboards: add 'gridlock' dashboard combining per-region SLO burn, queue depth per serving-pod, KV miss rate, circuit-breaker state timeseries, and fallback latency. Create alert runbooks for 'fallback failure > 10%' and 'sustained queue depth > threshold for 2m'. Instrument experiment with trace sampling 100% for affected routes for 15m windows.
safety_and_abort_criteria: Immediate abort and rollback if: 1) overall customer error-budget consumption increases >30% for any org in 15m window, 2) cascading failover causes >3 regions to exceed CPU/GC thresholds simultaneously, or 3) data-plane KV corruption detected. All simulation steps use non-destructive hooks (header flags) to ensure customer traffic is protected when required.
investigation_findings: 2026-03-03: dev dry-run showed unexpected request queue accumulation in the router when GPU pool capacity fell below 8% — root cause: router's per-host inflight limit configured too high (500) for degraded capacity

2026-03-05: dependency-silence injected at proxy layer caused clients to retry aggressively due to exponential backoff misconfiguration; surfaced need for global retry budget and per-tenant rate controllers
2026-03-09: circuit breaker thresholds were too permissive for large-batch routes; breakers opened too late and saturation cascaded into neighboring model variants
mitigations_implemented: Lowered per-host inflight limit to 120 during capacity-degraded mode
Introduced global retry budget token bucket to cap cross-service retries per-second
Tuned circuit-breaker Hysteresis: reduce open threshold and add faster half-open probing with capped concurrent probes
